sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 2). Radios: frequencies, antennas, and why height beats power every time.
📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Axel Michalski. Programmer. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Reading Glasses, Knife roll, Carpenter's square, Busker's harmonica. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard
A woman, maybe 20s, with a wiry build: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 2). Falling pressure = weather coming. Your joints ache? That's a barometer. So are the birds — silent birds mean storm.
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 2). Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 2). Reverse-wrap technique makes rope strong enough to hold weight. Braid for more strength.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 2). Edges are the grocery store — where meadow meets woods, where water meets bank. Disturbed ground regrows first and fattest.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.
